scares.description: There's a loud thump in the background.
The mask is thrown out of the closet
A picture falls off the wall in the bedroom
A ghostly voice speaks and the lights begin flaring
A bowl is slowly pushed off a table
There are a few bangs and the closet opens
Something runs up to the feeder and turns off the camera
Nug mews quietly in the background
Someone gets dragged under the bed
Someone sits up in the background
